title: Page 8
lines: 有，当然有。
“你刚刚为什么吻他？”齐藤英树很想问这句，可他终究没开口，因为他的男性尊严不允许。
憋啊憋的，只能得内伤……
内伤，需要疗癒，近乎野蛮的需索，他要她的臣服。
一路上的沉默酝酿的是更大的风暴，英俊优雅的男人在褪去那尊贵王者的伪装后，依然迷人，却带着一丝冷峻的魔魅之气。
回到饭店，齐藤英树一进门，二话不说就把席舞压在门上，低头便攫取她的红唇。
熟悉的街道与院落，连花香都是她记忆中的穗花山奈。
他说要带她来的地方，竟然是这里？
席舞看着近在眼前的家，脚步却是不由自主地往后退，再往后退，直到她跌进一个宽阔温暖的胸膛。
“怎么了？”齐藤英树明知故问。
“你为什么带我来这里？”席舞心虚不已，连说话时的嗓音都在抖。
他把她抱紧，很温柔地对她说：“住在这里的夫妇是舞冬末的父母，虽然他们不知道我骗了他们女儿的事，但我对他们一直都感到很愧疚，尤其是在舞冬末掉下山崖失踪了之后，他们竟一点都没有怪罪我们，这让我更难过，所以，我每年都会找时间来看看他们。”
说着，齐藤英树低头吻上了她光洁好看的额头。“他们在我心里，就像我的父亲母亲一样，虽然我从未对他们说过，但每次来探望他们，我都可以在他们这里得到慰藉，感觉舞冬末还活着一样，我并不孤单。”
席舞听了眼睛泛红，很是感动。当年她选择不再回来，不再当舞冬末，就是因为太痛太伤，觉得这样离开对大家都是种解脱，齐藤英树不必因为愧对她而说要娶她，她也不必再活在被所爱的人抛弃及让渡给别人的阴影中……
当时的她，太爱他，也太恨他，她活得很痛苦，怎么做对她而言都是种残酷的凌迟，何况那个家，应该没有人是真心欢迎她，她的存在带给太多人痛苦和无奈，不管是齐藤英树还是齐藤浅羽，甚至是安本香子……
说到底，她这么做唯一对不起的人是她的亲生父母——他们爱她疼她，却必须承受爱女已死的事实，虽然她当时并不是故意的。
她昏迷了一阵，又病了太久，硬是要黑少藏起她的行踪、她的一切，连她的父母也不透露半点，除了不想让他们担心受累，也是不想让齐藤家有任何一丝的线索可以找到她，而当她真的痊癒之后，可以走出来面对人群时，他们早已承认了她已死的事实，她便也就将错就错……
这么多年来，她一直在旁偷偷看着他们却不敢靠近，如今，他却要把她带进这个家？何谓近乡情怯，就是她此刻的心境：喜欢却又害怕。
“因为他们就像我的父母一样，所以，我带我爱的女人来见他们，希望他们也可以像我一样喜欢你。”
“他们……会喜欢我吗？”
“一定会。我不是说过了吗？你很像舞冬未，他们看见你一定会开心得眼泪都掉下来，你可不要吓着了，嗯？”
席舞听了，鼻头酸酸的，她真的害怕见着他们两老之后会忍不住哭出来，这让她益发地踌躇不前。
“改天好吗？我一点准备都没有……”
“你什么都不必准备，因为我都准备好了，所有他们爱吃的爱用的。走吧，我事先说了今天要带朋友来，他们估计已等上许久了呢。”
“乖，就当弥补我心灵的创伤，你那天吻了别的男人不是吗？”齐藤英树突然板起一张俊脸，轻哼一声。“我让你做了我不喜欢的事，今天你也得陪我做你不喜欢的事。”
这样也算是一种惩罚吗？在经过昨夜的激情缠绵之后？
何况，这件事根本不是她不喜欢的事，相反的，是她在内心深处渴望极了的事，不知想上几年几月的事。
席舞看着他，心，更软了，像是要化掉一样。
他是不是知道了什么？所以这样对她好？
又或者，他根本把她当成了舞冬末，不管她究竟是不是个冒牌货？
她的心激动不已，却只能静静地注视着这个男人，什么话也不能说。
她爱他，绕了这许多路，她还是爱着他，他似乎也是爱她的，不管是他的身体他的举动他的眼神，她都可以感觉到他对她的爱，不是因为愧疚，不是因为利用，只是因为他喜欢她。
这样很好，真的很好，她一点都不想破坏这样宁静美好的关系。
“我没有不喜欢陪你做这件事。”
“是吗？”齐藤英树挑挑眉。“那就不算惩罚了，我得再来想想有什么是你不喜欢的，可我却非做不可的事才行。”
席舞淡笑着，突然反手紧紧抱住了他。
“我爱你，英树，你知道我爱你吧？”
“嗯，知道，昨天我抱你的时候你说了好多次。”
什么跟什么……
席舞脸一红，羞得不得了，手搥上他的胸。“不理你了！”
“那不行，主人在等我们了。”
齐藤英树牵住她的手，不让她有逃跑的念头，带着她进了院子。
走进舞家的客厅，屋内已传来浓浓的饭菜香，是她熟悉的妈妈的味道，像是早已经知道今天有客人要来似的，正在大费周章准备着。
“你来了，英树，这位应该就是你说的女朋友了吧？”第一个奔来开门的正是舞爸，他笑得很开心，跟齐藤英树打完招呼，一双眼睛就定定地落在席舞身上，虽然一句话都没说，可看得出眼底的激动。
“是的……伯父，我是席舞，很高兴认识你。”强忍住激动的泪水，席舞朝舞爸伸出了手。
舞爸笑呵呵，赶紧抓过她的手拍啊拍，感慨万千，泪水忍不住浮上了眼眶。
“舞爸更高兴看见你，就像看见自己的女儿一样，英树说的没错，你真的很像我的女儿冬末啊。”
舞妈从厨房走了出来，只是静静地在一旁看着她，却泪流满面。
席舞看见了母亲的泪，再怎么强忍，泪也终是溃堤……
她边擦泪边笑。“真是的，看见两位这样哭，害我也好想哭……”
齐藤英树伸手替她抹去泪。“席舞真的很像两位的女儿吧？那席舞以后就当你们的女儿好不好？”
嗄？席舞错愕地看着他。“英树？”
“不好吗？”齐藤英树微笑地看着她。“我知道你也是孤身一人，有干爸干妈疼你，你不开心？”
席舞还没回话，就听见舞爸呵呵直笑。
“当然好当然好，我们求之不得啊。”舞爸说着，偷偷低头擦泪。
舞妈终是迈着步伐过来拥抱住席舞。“好好好，我的女儿啊，以后你就一直是我的女儿了……”
席舞看着齐藤英树，终是点点头再点点头，哭得说不出话来。
阳光照耀进来，菜瓜棚里有小鸟儿跳跃，仔细点听，还有风吹动树梢的声音。
岁月静好。
她永远都不会忘记这个午后，再一次见到父母亲时的激动与感动，更不会忘记和父母亲再次同桌吃饭，桌上摆满一桌子她最爱的菜时的惊诧与迷惑，而会让她一辈子惦念着的是，因为齐藤英树的缘故，她以后可以名正言顺地叫他们一声爸一声妈，还可以理所当然地尽一份当女儿的孝心。
她生命中的缺口，因他而产生，也因他而填补。
喜怒哀乐，爱恨嗔痴，不管如何，她的爱都因他才终究完整。
十月，日本京都。
content_en:
Yes, of course.
"Why did you kiss him just now?" Saito Hideki wanted to ask this, but he didn't speak because his male dignity did not allow it.
If you hold it in, you will only get internal injuries...
Chapter 19(1)
Internal injuries, in need of healing, almost brutal demand, he wanted her surrender.
The silence along the way is brewing a bigger storm. After the handsome and elegant man sheds the disguise of the noble king, he is still charming, but with a hint of cold magic.
Back at the hotel, as soon as Saito Hideki entered the door, he pressed Xi Wu against the door without saying a word, lowered his head and grabbed her red lips.
The familiar streets and courtyards, even the fragrance of the flowers were the same as Hohana Kanna in her memory.
The place he said he wanted to take her to was actually here?
Xi Wu looked at the home in front of her, but her steps involuntarily moved back, and then back again, until she fell into a broad and warm chest.
"What's wrong?" Saito Hideki asked knowingly.
"Why did you bring me here?" Xi Wu felt guilty, and his voice was shaking even when he spoke.
He hugged her tightly and said to her very gently: "The couple who live here are Wu Dongmo's parents. Although they don't know that I lied to their daughter, I have always felt guilty for them, especially after Wu Dongmo fell off the cliff and disappeared. They didn't blame us at all, which makes me even sadder. Therefore, I find time to visit them every year."
Saito Hideki lowered his head and kissed her smooth and beautiful forehead. "They are in my heart, just like my father and mother. Although I have never told them, every time I come to visit them, I can get comfort from them. I feel as if Wu Dongmo is still alive and I am not alone."
Xi Wu's eyes turned red after hearing this, and she was very moved. Back then, she chose not to come back and stop being Wu Dongmo because it was too painful and hurtful. She felt that leaving like this would be a relief for everyone. Saito Hideki didn't have to say that he wanted to marry her because he was ashamed of her, and she no longer had to live in the shadow of being abandoned by the one she loved and giving it to someone else...
At that time, she loved him too much and hated him too much. She lived in pain. No matter what she did, it was cruel to her. What's more, no one in that family really welcomed her. Her existence brought pain and helplessness to too many people, whether it was Saito Hideki, Saito Asaha, or even Yasumoto Kyouko...
After all, the only people she was sorry for were her biological parents - they loved her and loved her, but they had to bear the fact that their beloved daughter was dead, even though she didn't mean it at the time.
She had been in a coma for a while and had been sick for a long time. She insisted that Young Master Hei hide her whereabouts and everything about her, not even revealing anything about her to her parents. In addition to not wanting them to worry about getting involved, she also didn't want the Saito family to have any clues to find her. And when she really recovered and could come out to face the crowd, they had already admitted the fact that she was dead, so she just made the mistake...
For so many years, she has been secretly watching them but not daring to come close. Now, he wants to bring her into this home? What does it mean to be timid about being close to home? It's her state of mind at the moment: she likes it but is afraid.
"Because they are like my parents, so I brought the woman I love to meet them. I hope they can like you like me."
"Will they... like me?"
"Definitely. Didn't I say it before? You look a lot like Wu Dongwei. They will be so happy that they shed tears when they see you. Don't be scared, okay?"
Xi Wu's nose felt sour after hearing this. She was really afraid that she would cry after seeing the two elders, which made her even more hesitant.
"How about another day? I'm not prepared at all..."
"You don't have to prepare anything, because I have prepared everything they like to eat and use. Let's go. I told you in advance that I would bring friends here today. They must have been waiting for a long time."
"Hideki..."
"Be good, just make up for the trauma in my heart. You kissed another man that day, didn't you?" Hideki Saito suddenly put on a handsome face and snorted softly. "I asked you to do something I don't like, and you have to accompany me to do something you don't like today."
Is this considered a punishment? After last night's passionate lovemaking?
What's more, this matter is not something she doesn't like at all. On the contrary, it is something she longs for deep in her heart. She has been thinking about it for years and months.
Xi Wu looked at him, her heart softened even more, as if it was about to melt.
Did he know something? So this is good for her?
Or maybe he simply regarded her as Wu Dongmo, regardless of whether she was a fake or not?
Her heart was filled with excitement, but she could only stare at this man quietly, unable to say anything.
She loved him, and after all these detours, she still loved him, and he seemed to love her too. No matter it was his body, his actions, or his eyes, she could feel his love for her, not because of guilt or use, just because he liked her.
This was good, really good. She didn't want to ruin such a peaceful and beautiful relationship at all.
"I don't like doing this with you."
"Really?" Saito Hideki raised his eyebrows. "Then it's not punishment. I have to think about what you don't like, but I have to do it."
Xi Wu smiled lightly and suddenly hugged him tightly.
"I love you, Hideki, you know I love you, right?"
"Yeah, I know. You said it many times when I hugged you yesterday."
What and what...
Xi Wu's face turned red and she was so embarrassed that she slapped his chest with her hands. "Ignore you!"
"That won't work, the master is waiting for us."
Saito Hideki held her hand to prevent her from thinking of escaping, and took her into the yard.
When she walked into the dancer's living room, the strong aroma of food could already be heard in the house. It was the smell of her mother that she was familiar with. It was as if she already knew that a guest was coming today and was putting a lot of effort into preparing it.
"You're here, Hideki. This must be the girlfriend you mentioned, right?" The first one to open the door was Wu's dad. He smiled happily. After saying hello to Saito Hideki, his eyes fell firmly on Xi Wu. Although he didn't say a word, you could see the excitement in his eyes.
"Yes...Uncle, I am Xi Wu, nice to meet you." Holding back the tears of excitement, Xi Wu stretched out her hand towards Wu's father.
The dance dad laughed and quickly grabbed her hand and patted it. He was filled with emotion and tears couldn't help but come to his eyes.
"Dad Wu is more happy to see you, just like seeing his own daughter. Hideki is right, you really look like my daughter Dong Su."
The dance mother came out of the kitchen and just looked at her quietly, with tears streaming down her face.
Xi Wu saw her mother's tears. No matter how hard she tried to hold back, the tears eventually burst...
She smiled while wiping away tears. "Really, seeing you two crying like this makes me want to cry..."
Saito Hideki reached out to wipe away her tears. "Xi Wu really looks like your daughter, right? Then Xi Wu will be your daughter from now on, okay?"
Huh? Xi Wu looked at him in astonishment. "Hideki?"
"Isn't it good?" Saito Hideki looked at her with a smile. "I know you are also alone. You have a godfather who loves you. Are you unhappy?"
Before Xi Wu could reply, she heard Wu's father laughing.
"Of course, of course, we can't ask for it." Wu Dad said, secretly lowering his head to wipe his tears.
The dance mother finally stepped over and hugged Xi Wu. "Okay, okay, my daughter, you will always be my daughter from now on..."
Xi Wu looked at Saito Hideki, and finally nodded again and again, crying until he could not speak.
The sun shines in, and there are birds jumping in the vegetable shed. If you listen carefully, there is also the sound of the wind blowing the treetops.
The years are quiet.
She will never forget this afternoon, the excitement and touch when she saw her parents again, and she will never forget the surprise and confusion when she and her parents ate at the same table again, with a table full of her favorite dishes. What will make her think about her whole life is that because of Saito Hideki, she can legitimately call them dad and mom in the future, and can also fulfill her filial piety as a daughter.
The gap in her life was created and filled by him.
Joy, anger, sorrow, love, hate, anger and ignorance, no matter what, her love was ultimately complete because of him.
October, Kyoto, Japan.
